description: Office of the Regional Assistant Commissioner of Local Government Mullativu - Declaration of Built up Area - Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with the declaration of built-up areas and land boundaries within the Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabha limits. It contains detailed land surveys, boundary changes, and zoning designations for specific villages and wards, including acreage measurements and geographical boundaries. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land use planning, zoning changes, and property boundary definitions.
